edition.en: Poems, Third Series (1896), edited by Mabel Loomis Todd, on Project Gutenberg (eBook 12242)
edition.zh: 据古登堡计划电子书 12242 所录《诗集·第三辑》（1896），托德编

basis.en: First published in 1896 in Poems, Third Series, after the author’s death in 1886; the editor, Mabel Loomis Todd, died in 1932.
basis.zh: 1896 年首次出版于《诗集·第三辑》，作者已于 1886 年去世；编者梅布尔·卢米斯·托德卒于 1932 年。

note.en: Dickinson describes a quality of early-spring light “that science cannot overtake”, and then the small loss when it passes. The last image, of trade encroaching on a sacrament, is startling and exact.
note.zh: 狄金森写早春的一种光，“科学追不上它”，然后写它离开时那一点小小的失落。最后一个意象——买卖侵入了圣礼——出人意料，又精确无比。

excerpt.orig:
A color stands abroad
On solitary hills
That science cannot overtake,
But human nature feels.
excerpt.en:
A color stands abroad
On solitary hills
That science cannot overtake,
But human nature feels.
excerpt.zh:
一种颜色便伫立在外，
在孤寂的山丘上，
科学追不上它，
人的天性却能感到。
